title: Constant sheaves of a short exact sequence of abelian groups form a sequence exact even as presheaves
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that applying the constant sheaf functor to a short exact sequence of abelian groups yields a sequence that is exact as sheaves and even as presheaves. Exactness at the first two spots and injectivity follow from exactness of sheafification together with the fact that the presheaf kernel coincides with the sheaf kernel in this situation; the remaining point, surjectivity of the constant sheaf of the quotient, is proved by choosing a set-theoretic section of the surjection and observing that it induces a section of the map of constant sheaves left inverse to the surjection (proof lines 8423-8434). H2: the set-theoretic section argument that produces presheaf surjectivity is the substance.
